# `preferEffectString`

Suggests Effect String APIs for native String method invocations, with semantic caveats

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Effect-native |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377150` |
| Language Service name | `preferEffectString` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/prefer-effect-string` |

## Preview

```ts
import * as Str from "effect/String"

const email = "alice@example.com"
export const native = email.indexOf("@")
/**
                            ^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(prefer-effect-string): Consider effect/String.indexOf instead of native String.indexOf. Returns Option<number>, with None replacing -1; there is no position parameter.
*/
export const preferred = Str.indexOf("@")(email)
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "preferEffectString": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

See the [Oxlint setup guide](../README.md#oxlint-setup) for installation and patching instructions.

```json
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/oxlint-schema.json",
  "options": {

  },
```
